newsitem.title: UK: Allied Colloids gets $503 mln takeover loans.
newsitem.headline: Allied Colloids gets $503 mln takeover loans.

text.p: LONDON, November 20 (LPC) - British chemicals company Allied Colloids Plc has secured $503 million of bank loans to help finance its $390 million acquisition of CPS Chemical Company, public documents show.
Dresdner Bank AG has provided Allied Colloids Group with a bridging loan of 180 million stg to assist in the acquisition.
At the same time, NatWest Markets is arranging for Allied Colloids subsidiaries a $200 million loan package split into a $125 million term loan and a 45 million stg revolver.

The NatWest package matures in November of 2001 and is priced 30 bps over LIBOR with a 15 bps commitment fee. Funds will be used to purchase shares in CPS, to repay maturing loans and for general corporate purposes.
The bridging loan is priced 20 bps over LIBOR and runs until February 7, 1997. Both loans were dated November 19.

Allied Colloids will also make a two-for-seven rights issues at 118p per share to raise about 173 million stg net. It said net gearing on a pro-forma basis of the enlarged group was just under 61 percent as of November 1.
The company expects to have net gearing of 53 percent by March 31, 1997, with strong interest cover, and gearing to fall steadily thereafter.
U.S. company CPS Chemical is a manufacturer of high value intermediates for industrial use.
